617197f7a6bc: What is Umrah management software for travel agencies?
6e53d88fa5c5: Umrah management software centralizes the entire cycle of a pilgrimage program: package preparation, sales to customers, participant tracking and departure organization. Travelife Omra brings these steps together in a structured file per departure: hotels in Makkah and Madinah, nights, room types, sales, payments, rooming lists and passenger lists. Sales, operations and management teams work from the same information instead of juggling scattered Excel files. The software integrates with the Travelife suite (Admin, Manage, SmartCRM).
e353b2044a65: What is the Travelife Omra hybrid model?
9bd765e3decd: The hybrid model combines the flexibility of direct sales and tailor-made offers with the rigor of structured, file-based management. It lets your teams configure flexible packages while keeping centralized, smooth and consistent tracking across all departures.
9c25dbbb9614: How does offline file management work?
0d19069f99cb: Your team organizes each departure in a single file. There you record proposals, track customer sales, link participants and centralize operational details. The result: fewer scattered files and information instantly accessible to sales and operations teams.
66e8d6ce6da4: Do I need an online booking engine to use Travelife Omra?
65f5f75a2239: No. The “100% offline management” mode lets you prepare the file directly and enter your sales without going through a booking engine. It's the simplest starting point for an agency selling its Umrah packages over the counter, by phone or through its networks. Whenever you're ready, you can structure a sales catalog to present your departures, packages and rooms in a booking engine, then move on to advanced costing. All three modes share the same sales and operations tracking.
e1963cdf8f3f: Is Travelife Omra suitable for both reseller agencies and program organizers?
88b0000af059: Yes. Travelife Omra is designed both for reseller agencies, which sell existing programs, and for agencies that build their own Umrah programs. The former mainly rely on offline management and the sales catalog; the latter also use advanced costing, which calculates cost prices and rates from their purchase contracts. In both cases, each departure keeps its participants, rooms and operational details in a file shared by the whole team.
784404b5be9c: How are offers between Makkah and Madinah prepared?
150023211e11: The central administration (Admin module) lets you assign your hotels, nights, room types (double, triple, quad) and accommodation capacities to each package. This unified structure gives your teams a common reference to sell the offer and prepare its operations with complete peace of mind.
204522239fd4: How is the online sales catalog structured?
7823695a5206: The catalog centralizes all your programs and packages ready for sale, feeding directly into your booking engine and making the offers easy for your customers to understand.
ee9bb306ad49: How does advanced costing calculate cost prices?
c135ec509f50: Costing centralizes your purchase contracts (flights, hotels, additional services). Configured rules automate calculations based on the package, room occupancy and departure settings. Any change in your purchase costs is instantly reflected in the costing according to your rules, giving you full control over prices.
6bda64cf4cec: What is the difference between projected margin and actual result?
3b3092097518: The projected margin is calculated upfront during the pricing simulation (costing). The result, on the other hand, is based on the sales, payments and purchases actually recorded in the file. Sales activity and costs are reconciled directly from the sales and purchase journals and the operations sheet.
d83cac8d1406: How do I track orders, payments and invoicing?
15bc7b510c74: Everything is centralized in the sales module. From the invoiced customer to the overall financial view of the departure, you track payments, invoicing and collections in real time.
4e81da977d50: How are rooming lists and on-site logistics managed?
1988166e2e5f: The operations module organizes participants and rooms by departure, city and hotel. It automatically generates the rooming lists and passenger lists essential for a smooth trip.
c6a087fb1dd2: How does Travelife Omra fit into our agency management?
22c98866d943: Travelife Omra relies on the complete Travelife ecosystem: offer preparation in Admin, orders and operations management in Manage, and customer relationship tracking in SmartCRM depending on your setup.
0f8bc1355c0e: How can I get a demo of the Travelife Omra software?
ec511136946b: Request a demo from the contact page, by phone at (+212) 5 21 50 06 05 or by email at contact@travelife.ma. The Travelife team will present the software using your own Umrah programs: preparing packages between Makkah and Madinah, choosing the management mode (offline, catalog or costing), tracking sales and payments, then organizing rooms and rooming lists.
